messages:
yang: kicking off a pulse-gate rollout for rwd-v6-int4-smoke. plan: staged 1% -> 5% -> 20% over ~3h with health checks and auto-fallback. posting proposed trigger conditions so we can iterate.

gabe: +1. want to make sure fallback ties to relative delta not absolute for MRR. propose: fail if MRR_drop_pct > 1.5% OR halluc_rate_pp_increase > 0.3 OR latency_p95_increase_ms > 30. keep quotas conservative for first two steps.

mira: also add a long-doc slice check (LDoc-MRR). last time we saw regressions there only visible after ~10k long-doc queries. if LDoc-MRR drops > 2% abort and roll back immediately.

yang: agreed. here's a minimal rollout snippet I put together for the console — happy to iterate:
```
rollout_id: RL-20260323-42
model: rwd-v6-int4-smoke
steps:
  - percent: 1
    duration: 00:30:00
  - percent: 5
    duration: 01:00:00
  - percent: 20
    duration: 01:30:00
auto_fallback:
  - metric: MRR
    comparator: relative_decrease
    threshold_pct: 1.5
  - metric: HALLUC_RATE
    comparator: absolute_increase
    threshold_pp: 0.3
  - metric: LATENCY_P95
    comparator: absolute_increase_ms
    threshold_ms: 30
slices:
  - name: longdoc
    metric: MRR
    comparator: relative_decrease
    threshold_pct: 2.0
```

gabe: can we also wire a soft-warning channel at 0.5% MRR drop so we can human-check before rollback? maybe `warning_threshold_pct: 0.5` and only auto-fallback past 1.5.

mira: yes — add a soft-warning and an evaluation window of 10 minutes for each step to reduce noisy spikes. for longdoc slice, require 30 min window.

yang: good call. I'll update config: add warning_threshold_pct: 0.5 and eval_windows: step=10m, longdoc=30m. also will start a 30m micro-shadow run against production traffic before first step to surface obvious regressions.

deploy-bot: rollout RL-20260323-42 created in staging -> waiting for manual kick. runbook: https://console.internal/runbooks/pulse-gate-rollout (permissions required).

oncall-sre: tagging @oncall-sre so ops are on deck for 3h window. I'll watch infra metrics (preempt, OOM, queue depth). call me if we see node eviction patterns.

yang: next steps: 1) mira to update slice definitions and thresholds in config (ETA 30m) 2) gabe to add warning channel hooks (ETA 20m) 3) yang to kick micro-shadow once updated (ETA 45m). if any one metric breaches auto-fallback rules we roll back and create a postmortem. :robot_face:

mira: will also export a small smoke eval harness (1k queries across 6 slices) to run before step 2. sharing results to this thread.

gabe: thanks — I expect to see the warning webhook fire first if anything subtle happens. ping me if it hits. :thumbsup:
